sources: Industry 0.1 (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0003): Strength and ATK% lines are on the stat panel. rmxlinux SkillData sk_wpn_claym_0003: passiveEventActions abilityEvent 302 (the wielder deals damage) + CheckDamageDecorateMask checkType 2 mask 256 (a battle-skill hit) → CreateBuff buff_wpn_claym_0003 (attr 2, formulaItem 6: ATK + atk_up; `duration` 20 s at every level; stackingType 4: a new one refreshes it). Description: "When the wielder's battle skill hits the enemy, the wielder gains ATK +{atk_up} for {duration}s. Effects of the same name cannot stack."
Wielder-relative: any battle-skill hit by the wielder. A trigger's own hits (damageType none, decorate mask 0, e.g. Catcher's P1 strike) don't count.
